name: The Warehouse Lock
offerText: The warehouse job is ready. Bring your lockpicks.
description: Dusan needs a sealed ledger recovered from the warehouse. The delivery markings suggest official and unofficial shipments use the same route.

stages.description: At night, pick the factory entrance door and loot the Precision core from the unlocked crate on the warehouse ground floor. Buy and carry extra tools from Dusan to improve Lockpicking if needed.
Return to Dusan Markovic and hand over the Precision core.

_codex.narrativeIntent: A sealed ledger shows that some shipments reach a restricted factory warehouse.
implementationNotes: Keep existing warehouse container and loot.
_codex.compatibility: _codex is design metadata, not an executable trigger. Keep all original IDs, trigger shapes, rewards, and existing save compatibility. Add runtime support only after implementing the documented systems.
